notes.subject: Mamelang
notes.rationale: Puo e bula ka kopa ho mamela: 'Mamelang lentswe le' — mosebetsi wa ho bitsha mobadi.

notes.subject: dinama tsa Bashane
notes.rationale: Tlhahlobo e tobile ho basadi ba maemo a hodimo ba Shomrone, ba bitsoang 'dinama' ka tshwantshiso.

notes.subject: בשן / Bashane
notes.rationale: Bashane e ne e le sebaka sa dinama tse nonneng; tshwantshiso e tobile ebile e nyatsa — 'dinama tsa Bashane' eseng 'basadi ba Shomrone' ka ho toba.

notes.subject: פרות
notes.rationale: Boima bja puo: basadi ba bitsoa dinama tse nonneng tse jeleng bokgotsi bja dimilione tse nyabotswang — setshwantshiso se se nang thobalano, se sieang Sesothong.

translation: Mamelang lentswe le, lona dinama tsa Bashane tse dile thabeng ya Shomrone, tse khotsokeletsang ba fokolang, tse phatlohang ba hlokang, tse reng ho beng tsa tsona: Isa mme re noe.
